quality_dimensions.depth: Covers the full profile-backed specification route, lifecycle obligations, independent review, canonical promotion, reconciliation, and handoff boundary with explicit failure handling.
quality_dimensions.evidence_use: Links every completion claim to a named contract, repository artifact, transition receipt, capability result, or external fact instead of relying on completion narration.
quality_dimensions.seed_retention: Retains the reference service profile, folder contract, dependency waves, required review and quality gates, and the operator's prohibition on unauthorized external mutation.
quality_dimensions.adjudication: Preserves conflicting canonical and staged work, identifies the disputed obligation, and stops for an operator decision without choosing by timestamp.
quality_dimensions.lifecycle_completeness: Reaches a validated mission-control handoff only after implementation specification, plan review, work, code review, quality assurance, artifact promotion, and receipt settlement are complete.
